reference.measured_quantity: water height in front of the obstacle, peak value and arrival time

verified_against: 3.22 m tank, 1.22 m column, 0.55 m column height, 0.40 x 0.16 x 0.16 m box placed 1.248 m downstream (A. English et al. 2021, doi:10.1007/s40571-021-00403-3, Sec. 'Three-dimensional dam-break flow with a fixed structure')

experimental_values.reason: Kleefsman et al. (2005) report the water-height traces graphically (gauges H1-H4). The paper PDF could not be retrieved from this node: the University of Groningen repository copy (research.rug.nl/files/2941055/2005JCompPhysKleefsman.pdf) is behind a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403), ScienceDirect returns HTTP 403, and no digitized table of the Kleefsman water-level traces was found in the openly reachable literature. The gauge x-coordinates of H1-H4 are printed only inside the setup figure, not in its caption or body text.
experimental_values.resolve_by: obtain the paper PDF via an institutional subscription, read the water-height traces at the gauge nearest the box, and fill peak_height_m / arrival_time_s / probe_x_m here; benchmarks/kleefsman_obstacle/run.py then performs the <10% tolerance check automatically and flips the verdict from WITHHELD to PASS/FAIL.

tolerance.rule: |got - ref| / |ref| < 0.10 for both the peak height and the arrival time
